archetypes.name: chart-window
archetypes.rationale: Filtered chart windows can diverge from round table windows.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Gantt extraction flow for off-by-one and fallback behavior. Verify chart_start and chart_end always come from displayed rows, while table Time and Cost still use the skill-filtered round window. Check that empty filtered sets render the no-task note instead of a renderer failure. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: filter-scope
archetypes.rationale: The row filter must hide CI/probe noise without dropping reviewer tasks.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the AWK predicates for overly broad and overly narrow CI or launcher probe matching. Confirm slot-map matches remain visible unless their task kind or output basename is explicitly CI-like or probe-like. Pay special attention to ci-fix basenames and task-kind suffixes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
